publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.27 fixes private-network monitor setup and checks. The deployment runner command passes UPTIME_PRIVATE_GRANT_DIR to the runner so it can read matching grants and run private-network checks. It also passes the configured runner credential directory and independent watch settings. The monitor form shows the five-minute second-factor requirement above the grant field when you select My private network. Verify now lets you verify or add a factor in the form. If verification expires before saving, you can verify and continue with the same monitor details. When a local practice target address falls outside the running checkout's grant, the error points to rer run practice-target to obtain the current address. This release adds no database migrations and keeps the @runeditrun/rer pin at 0.2.131. Update and restart the deployed Node runner with your existing grant directory configured to pick up the runner fix. The backup and upgrade guidance under 0.5.26 still applies. Product screenshot available from 0.4.0 at .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-23.
